free_tier_limits.correction: F0 free tier: 1,000 transactions per month (Bing Search v7); S1 and other paid SKUs have separate quotas — do not treat F0/S1 as interchangeable free quotas.

rate_limits.correction: Published per SKU (e.g. F0: 3 transactions per second; S1: 250 TPS). Not “not published.”

description.correction: Bing Search APIs (including News Search) are being retired from Azure Cognitive Services; Microsoft has announced deprecation/migration away from the classic Bing Search product path. Calling it a current Azure Cognitive Services API without noting retirement status is misleading.

notes: Adversarial check found published rate limits and retirement/deprecation signals; free_tier_limits is too vague vs documented F0 quota. Verify retirement status on learn.microsoft.com before treating the API as fully operational.
